conceptual assets.concept: Per-region PMP configuration (permission bits, mode, lock)
conceptual assets.reasoning: pmpcfg is the stored per-region configuration written by the csr_pmpcfg process (`pmpcfg(i) <= ...` when `pmpcfg_we(...)= '1'` and `pmpcfg(i)(cfg_l_c) = '0'`) and read back into cfg_rd/cfg_rd32. perm_gen reads pmpcfg(r)(cfg_x_c/cfg_r_c/cfg_w_c/cfg_l_c) to form allow(r) and match_gen reads the mode bits to compute match(r). The RTL therefore requires correct pmpcfg values to compute allow/match and enforce access rules; corrupting pmpcfg would alter access decisions.

pmpaddr holds each region's address and is written by csr_pmpaddr (`pmpaddr(i) <= "00" & ctrl_i.csr_wdata(...)` when `pmpaddr_we(i) = '1'` and `pmpcfg(i)(cfg_l_c) = '0'`). cmp_ge/cmp_lt and cmp_na use pmpaddr(r)(XLEN-3 downto pmp_lsb_c-2) (and addr_mask) to compute region-match conditions used by match_gen. The RTL therefore requires correct pmpaddr values to compute matching; corrupting pmpaddr changes which accesses match a region.

conceptual assets.concept: CSR write-decode decisions that enable PMP register writes
conceptual assets.reasoning: The CSR-write qualification is computed into pmpcfg_we (`csr_we_cfg` process) and pmpaddr_we (`csr_we_addr` process) from CSR address/strobe inputs and these internal signals gate the register writes in csr_pmpcfg and csr_pmpaddr (`if pmpcfg_we(...) = '1' ...` and `if pmpaddr_we(i) = '1' ...`). The correctness of these write-enable decode signals is required so that CSR writes land only in the intended PMP registers.

match(r) is computed in match_gen from pmpcfg mode bits and the compare signals cmp_ge/cmp_lt/cmp_na (`match(r) <= ...` in match_gen) and selects which region (if any) applies to the current acc_addr. match(r) is consumed by the failure chain (`fail(r) <= not allow(r) when (match(r) = '1') else fail(r+1)`). The RTL therefore requires correct match results to determine violations.

conceptual assets.concept: Per-region permission decision (allow) computed for the current access
conceptual assets.reasoning: allow(r) is computed in perm_gen from access type signals (lsu_mo_we/lsu_rw), acc_priv and pmpcfg bits (`allow(r) <= pmpcfg(r)(cfg_x_c/ cfg_r_c/ cfg_w_c) ... or (not pmpcfg(r)(cfg_l_c))` depending on acc_priv and access type). allow(r) is used by the fail-generation logic to declare a PMP violation. The RTL therefore requires the correctness (integrity) of allow to enforce access control.

conceptual assets.concept: Selected access context (address and privilege) used for matching and permission checks
conceptual assets.reasoning: acc_addr is the selected address used in comparisons (`acc_addr <= ctrl_i.pc_nxt when (ctrl_i.lsu_mo_we = '0') else addr_ls_i`) and acc_priv is the selected privilege (`acc_priv <= ctrl_i.cpu_priv when (ctrl_i.lsu_mo_we = '0') else ctrl_i.lsu_priv`). cmp_ge/cmp_lt/cmp_na and perm_gen use acc_addr and acc_priv; fail(NUM_REGIONS) also depends on acc_priv. The RTL therefore requires correct acc_addr and acc_priv values for correct PMP decisioning.

conceptual assets.concept: Fault indication produced when PMP rejects an access
conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL computes a failure vector (`fail(NUM_REGIONS) <= '1' when (acc_priv /= priv_mode_m_c) else '0'` and `fail(r) <= not allow(r) when (match(r) = '1') else fail(r+1)`) and then registers/exports the fault signal in fault_check (`fault_o <= (not ctrl_i.cpu_debug) and fail(0)` on rising_edge). The exported fault_o reports PMP violations; integrity of the computed fail result and the resulting fault_o is required to accurately signal violations.
